notes: The 42 one-point candidate validation games were measured before the later multi-point-only scoring fix. Their one-point search logic is unchanged; source hashes for both stages are provided. The four three-point games were repeated after that fix.

Development and rejected variants are separate from final candidate results. The rejected variant won 20/20 against the original in a narrow opening pool but lost 7/20 against the previous version in the wider pool.
Paired seeds may duplicate boards or overlap development starts. These matches are not independent samples, a balanced-book certification or an Elo estimate.
No illegal-move forfeits: fallback replacements are counted by engine.
A planned full-opening run of the rejected variant was canceled before any game completed; it is not a validation result.
One earlier build attempt encountered ENOENT under a generated .rsync-tmp path. An unchanged-source retry and the final-candidate build both succeeded.
